summary: Revising a schedule's owning mission run no longer misclassifies its new generation as an ownership move and indefinitely blocks stale-peer admission.

replay.detail: No replay or backfill; existing catch-up and occurrence deduplication apply.

rules.detail: No replication or retention rule changes.

compatibility.detail: A generation change with the same owning run and declaring step is a revision. Actual owning-run, declaring-step, primary-placement changes and retained standbys remain fail-closed for stale positive peer comparisons.

downtime.detail: No live-state changes or activation included.

recovery.detail: Primary-only schedules revised in place can resume after a positive comparison becomes stale, subject to the existing startup and ownership barriers.
